candidate_invariant.name: LOCAL_AFFINE_CONSEQUENCE_CLOSURE
candidate_invariant.definition: Partition clauses by their underlying variable support S, |S|<=3. For each support bundle F_S, enumerate its locally satisfying assignments R_S and compute all affine GF(2) equations valid on every point of R_S. Union these sound local equations and compute their global linear closure by Gaussian elimination.

polynomial_computation.local_truth_tables: Each support has at most 3 variables, hence at most 8 assignments and at most 16 possible affine equations a·x=b to test.
polynomial_computation.global_closure: All valid equations from all support bundles form a polynomial-size linear system over GF(2); row reduction is polynomial.
authorized_outputs: If a local bundle has no satisfying assignment, return UNSAT.
If the global affine system is inconsistent, return UNSAT.
If the system forces x=c, assign x=c and simplify F.
If the system forces x xor y=c, quotient y to x xor c and simplify F.
polynomial_computation.important_scope: Higher-weight affine equations may be retained as evidence but do not by themselves authorize arbitrary substitution into CNF; only consequences whose exact CNF simplification is proved receive descent authority.

exactness_theorem.soundness: Every model of F restricts on each support S to a point in R_S, so every model of F satisfies every equation extracted from Aff(R_S). Therefore every equation in the global GF(2) closure is a logical consequence of F.
exactness_theorem.safe_assignment: If the closure forces x=c, then every model of F has x=c, hence SAT(F) iff SAT(F[x=c]).
exactness_theorem.safe_equivalence: If the closure forces x xor y=c, then every model obeys y=x xor c, so quotient substitution preserves satisfiability exactly.
exactness_theorem.strict_progress: Any forced unit or nontrivial two-literal affine congruence removes at least one Boolean degree of freedom without branching or a SAT oracle.

strict_novelty_from_R43A.R43A: recognized exact width-3 XOR bundles whose whole local relation was affine and then solved that affine subsystem exactly
strict_novelty_from_R43A.R44AY: extracts only sound affine consequences from arbitrary OR-clause support bundles even when the local relation itself is non-affine; only forced unit/equivalence consequences receive SAT-preserving descent authority

consumes_prior_rigid_obstruction.gadget: The four exact-3 clauses (x OR a OR b), (x OR a OR not b), (x OR not a OR b), (x OR not a OR not b) have local satisfying relation exactly x=1 with a,b arbitrary.
consumes_prior_rigid_obstruction.affine_effect: A_3 extracts the unit equation x=1, so the exact-width-3 sign-flip-rigid obstruction used in R44AW is consumed by an exact polynomial safe assignment.

nonuniversality.single_clause_fact: A single signed 3-clause has seven satisfying assignments. Their affine hull is all GF(2)^3 (for the positive clause, 111,110,101,011 are affinely independent; sign flips preserve affine dimension). Hence a support containing exactly one 3-clause contributes no nontrivial affine equation.
nonuniversality.UNSAT_obstruction_basis: Published constructions give unsatisfiable linear 3-CNF formulas: any two distinct clauses share at most one variable, so in particular no two clauses have the same 3-variable support.
nonuniversality.arbitrarily_large_UNSAT: Take one fixed unsatisfiable linear 3-CNF and disjointly union arbitrarily many fresh satisfiable single 3-clauses. The result remains UNSAT, linear, exact width 3, has unique clause support for every clause, empty binary core, and no local affine equations.
nonuniversality.arbitrarily_large_SAT: A disjoint union of fresh single positive 3-clauses is SAT and has the same fixed-point properties.
nonuniversality.sign_flip_rigidity: For a singleton sign pattern on a support, the local sign-translation stabilizer is zero on that support; if every variable appears in a clause, the global sign-flip group is therefore trivial. Thus these obstruction families also satisfy H(F)={0}.
nonuniversality.verdict: A_3 HAS ARBITRARILY LARGE SAT AND UNSAT FIXED POINTS EVEN INSIDE THE SIGN_FLIP_RIGID, BINARY_EMPTY, EXACT_WIDTH3 CORE

next_admissible_math.current_residual_core: sign-flip rigid + no explicit binary congruence + no forced unit/equivalence in the global closure of all support-local affine consequences
next_admissible_math.question: Find one polynomially computable exact invariant that strictly moves this triple-rigid core without DP, branching, proof search, bounded-local propagation repackaging, or hidden terminal SAT.
